NSCameraUsageDescription: Z-OUTLET uses the camera to take review, return and defect photos, to search with a picture, and, if you are a brand, product photos and ownership proof photos, only when you ask it to.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Z-OUTLET reads photos you choose to attach to reviews and returns or to search with, or, if you are a brand, brand product photos and ownership proof photos. Nothing else is read.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Z-OUTLET saves photos to your library only when you ask it to.
